description: 臺南市各漁港最大設籍停泊漁船筏艘數 [ports and harbours] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺南市政府農業局. 本資料集提供臺南市各漁港最大設籍停泊漁船筏艘數及可提供船席艘數資訊。. Coverage: Tainan City. The portal files it under the publisher 臺南市政府農業局. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json. The portal shows 2025-05-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
